model.title: A resolution honoring the life and legacy of Dolly Parton, a daughter of Tennessee whose extraordinary contributions to music, philanthropy, literacy, education, health, conservation, and culture enriched the lives of countless Americans.

summary.text: The resolution honors the life and legacy of Dolly Parton, expresses condolences to her family, friends, and the people of Tennessee, and recognizes her contributions in music, songwriting, entertainment, education, childhood literacy, health care, medical research, disaster relief, conservation, and philanthropy. It highlights her Dollywood Foundation and Imagination Library, her devotion to Tennessee, and honors such as her Country Music Hall of Fame induction, the Library of Congress Living Legend Medal, and the Carnegie Medal of Philanthropy. It encourages Americans to honor her memory by carrying forward her example of charity, kindness, service, and love of community.
